scenario_title: Group reading of a single-sheet text extract
minimal_context: The class is standing in a circle for a group reading activity to figure out the meaning of a text extract about a battle at the gates of Troy.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Everyone, please stand in a circle. We are going to read this text extract about what might be happening in a battle at the gates of Troy.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Slouches on a chair in the corner instead of joining the circle)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's figure out the meaning together. What do you think it means when the text says he was 'struck him on the ear'?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: He hit him hard on the ear.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Okay. Now we are going to take turns reading one phrase at a time. Here is the book, it is your turn to read.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Becomes angry and hostile when the book is given to him, unable to sound out the words)

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Everyone, please stand in a circle. We are going to read this text extract about what might be happening in a battle at the gates of Troy.

STUDENT: (Slouches on a chair in the corner instead of joining the circle)

TUTOR: Let's figure out the meaning together. What do you think it means when the text says he was 'struck him on the ear'?

STUDENT: He hit him hard on the ear.

TUTOR: Okay. Now we are going to take turns reading one phrase at a time. Here is the book, it is your turn to read.

STUDENT: (Becomes angry and hostile when the book is given to him, unable to sound out the words)

task.content: Reading a text extract about what might be happening in a battle at the gates of Troy, and articulating what 'struck him on the ear' means
task.learning_goal: To figure out meaning together and comprehend alongside everyone else

context.environment: Everyone stands in a circle, with a chair in the corner
context.social_setting: Group reading activity where peers take turns reading one phrase at a time, with the teacher reading the text once initially

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When a book was given to him
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: Unable to sound out words he had scored a zero on the reading test

behavior_patterns.condition: When everyone stands in a circle holding a single-sheet text extract
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Slouches on a chair in the corner

behavior_patterns.condition: When listening in from the sidelines as the teacher asks people in unison to echo back 'hurting words'
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Calls out 'He hit him hard on the ear.'
related_quotes: He hit him hard on the ear.
